leverage.exposure: A leveraged position is open — the balance went negative when Conté settled, and it stays negative until Amoako is sold. It is not dangerous today and it must not be left to drift. Not dangerous, because the matchday 2 lock passed on 04.09 with the balance comfortably positive, so no scored matchday has ever seen the red, and matchday 3 does not lock for more than six days. Must not drift, because the whole rule is that a negative balance at matchday start scores zero for the entire matchday, and the unwind lever decays every day it goes unused. The sale is instant and priced: Kickbase buys back at exactly market value, now measured eleven times out of eleven. Execute it today and the exposure is gone before it can ever matter.

binding_gap: The binding gap is not a position any more, it is the lineup. Conté sits unplaced while a zero-point body occupies a slot in the fielded eleven, and that gap is worth more than anything purchasable on the board. Behind it, the real constraint is structural: at eleven players a further sale triggers the short-squad penalty, so the usable ceiling collapses to whatever cash survives the unwind. That is roughly a tenth of the cheapest listing worth owning. Georg is fully invested, and until a sale exists that does not cost fielded points, runs should stop pricing the big names and simply log them.

verdict.headline: Conté landed.
verdict.detail: Conté landed. The offer settled uncontested at our own number a few minutes into this run, and the squad is now twelve with the balance in the red. Two actions close the loop, both today and neither urgent-by-deadline: sell Amoako to clear the negative, and place Conté in the eleven — until that lineup swap is made the money bought nothing at all. The board is otherwise shut to us: after the unwind we are fully invested, and every big name listed this run fails on affordability before merit is even reached.

sell.reason: Amoako, and only Amoako. This is the pre-priced second leg of the Conté trade, not a new idea, and it reverses the standing hold that protected him — say that out loud. That hold was right on its own premise and the premise is dead: it protected him as the eleventh body of an eleven-man squad, where selling meant ten players and the penalty. Conté makes twelve, so he is the twelfth body and the sale is free. He costs zero fielded points: no appearances, no minutes, two unused substitute call-ups per Ligainsider dated 05.09.2026. The alternatives are measured and both are worse — selling Widmer instead forces 3-4-3 and costs fielded points, selling Lokonga forces Amoako back into the eleven and costs more. Sell before the daily market-value tick this evening; he is decaying hard and every tick held costs real unwind.

standing.name: Amoako
standing.why: THE UNWIND. This is the pre-priced second leg of the Conte trade and it is now due. Conte (3204) settled to Georg Kitz 2026-09-05T12:52:14Z at 12.000.000 against mv 9.292.405 = +29,14%, exactly the Brncinm call, and the balance is now -566.376. Selling Amoako to Kickbase at mv 1.569.143 puts it at +1.002.767 and closes the leveraged position outright. REVERSES AND CLOSES Hjmhal7, WHICH SAID DO NOT SELL HIM - say that out loud to Georg. Hjmhal7 was right on its own premise and the premise is dead: it protected Amoako as the ELEVENTH BODY of an 11-man squad, where selling him meant 10 players and the -100 penalty. Conte makes the squad TWELVE, so Amoako is now the twelfth body and the sale is free. POINTS COST ZERO, MEASURED: Amoako has no ap field at all (0 points, 0 minutes, 0 apps, 2x unused sub per Ligainsider 05.09.2026), so he leaves the fielded eleven at 12 players anyway. Squad after the sale is 11 = 1GK/4DEF/3MID/3ATT, which IS 4-3-3 exactly, legal, fully placed, fielded points 1439. HE IS THE RIGHT BODY AND THE ALTERNATIVE IS MEASURED: selling Widmer instead (mv 1.852.587, +283.444 more cash) forces 3-4-3 and costs 29 fielded points; selling Lokonga (mv 9.731.816) forces Amoako back into the eleven and costs 44. Amoako is the only points-free sale on the books. TIMING - SELL BEFORE 20:00Z: market values tick at 2026-09-05T20:00:00Z (mvud, first-party) and Amoako is decaying hard - tfhmvt -49.393, sdmvt -811.827 - so every tick he is held costs ~50k of unwind. There is no matchday risk forcing the hand (MD3 locks 2026-09-11T18:30Z, ~149,6h away, and MD2's lock passed 04.09 18:30Z with the balance still at +11.433.624, so no scored matchday has ever seen the negative), but there is no reason on earth to wait either. AFTER THIS THE SQUAD IS AT 11 AND FULLY INVESTED: cash ~1,00M, zero further sales possible without triggering -100, so the usable buy ceiling is ~1,00M and nothing on the board is reachable. That is the correct state, not a problem to solve.

buy.reason: Nothing. Two new listings arrived since the last run and both are dead on arrival. Skarke is the cleanest cameo-average trap this ledger has recorded — his season average is one goal in a thirty-five-minute substitute appearance divided by one appearance, and Ligainsider has him at zero starts with a bench rate above eighty percent, out of Union's probable eleven at Leverkusen today. Olise is genuinely elite and entirely irrelevant: he fails on affordability by a factor of sixty-five. The same arithmetic kills Kimmich, Undav, Upamecano, Mittelstädt, Koch and Burger, all still listed, all already logged. Rohr is closed rather than missed — his abort condition was explicit and it fired the moment Conté won, since buying him on top would need leverage against an unwind that cannot cover it. He was the better asset on expected points and we knew it; the sequencing simply resolved the other way.
